engines.name: Google Shopping
engines.description: Scrapes Google Shopping search results: products, prices, sellers, ratings and filter options. Returns the first page (about 40 items) of results.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Search query as you would use in Google Shopping. Optional if shoprs is used.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates. City level recommended to simulate a real user. Cannot be combined with uule.

params.name: uule
params.label: Google-encoded location (uule)
params.help: Google-encoded location; cannot be combined with location. Coordinate-based uule requires a matching gl.

params.name: google_domain
params.label: Google domain
params.help: Google domain to use.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code (two or three letters), optionally with region, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: shoprs
params.label: Shopping filter token (shoprs)
params.help: Token containing query and filter metadata. Combine multiple filters with ||. q is not required when using it.

params.name: min_price
params.label: Minimum price
params.help: Lower price bound. Overrides the matching filter in shoprs.

params.name: max_price
params.label: Maximum price
params.help: Upper price bound. Overrides the matching filter in shoprs.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by
params.help: Sort order. Overrides shoprs.

params.name: free_shipping
params.label: Free shipping only
params.help: Show only products with free shipping. Overrides shoprs.

params.name: on_sale
params.label: On sale only
params.help: Show only products on sale. Overrides shoprs.

params.name: small_business
params.label: Small business only
params.help: Show only small-business products. Overrides shoprs.

params.name: safe
params.label: Safe search
params.help: Adult content filtering level. By default Google omits explicit content.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset
params.help: Currently ignored: Google Shopping's layout does not support offset pagination; every request returns the first page (~40 items).

params.name: num
params.label: Results per page
params.help: Accepted and forwarded to Google but the page size is fixed, so it does not change the result count.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device to emulate.

pagination.notes: start and num are accepted but ignored; each request returns the first page (about 40 items).

engines.aira_use: Price-check gear for a home office, interview outfits or certification books, and compare sellers before buying.

engines.name: Google Jobs
engines.description: Scrapes Google Jobs search results: job postings with company, location, source site, highlights and apply options. Up to 10 results per page via next_page_token.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: The job search query, e.g. 'barista new york'.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates. City level recommended to simulate a real user. Cannot be combined with uule.

params.name: uule
params.label: Google-encoded location (uule)
params.help: Google-encoded location; cannot be combined with location. Coordinate-based uule requires a matching gl.

params.name: google_domain
params.label: Google domain
params.help: Google domain to use.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, uk, fr.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code (two or three letters), optionally with region, e.g. en, es, fr, en-gb, es-419.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for the next page of results (up to 10 per page); returned at serpapi_pagination.next_page_token. Offset-based start is no longer supported.

params.name: chips
params.label: Chips
params.help: Additional query conditions from job search page chips, e.g. city:Owg_06VPwoli_nfhBo8LyA== returns results for New York. Deprecated by Google.

params.name: lrad
params.label: Search radius (km)
params.help: Search radius in kilometers. Does not strictly limit the radius.

params.name: ltype
params.label: Work from home
params.help: Filters results by work from home (commonly 1). Deprecated by Google; docs list no values.

params.name: uds
params.label: Filter string (uds)
params.help: Filter string provided by Google, found in the filters section of the response (filters[].parameters.uds).

pagination.notes: Use serpapi_pagination.next_page_token; serpapi_pagination.next is a ready URL. start is discontinued.

engines.aira_use: Discover open roles aggregated from many job boards with apply links, then feed job_id into listing lookups for company ratings.

engines.name: Google Jobs Listing
engines.description: Returns additional data for a Google Jobs listing identified by job_id, currently employer ratings from review sites such as Glassdoor and Indeed.

params.name: q
params.label: Job ID
params.help: The job_id string, obtainable from the Google Jobs API.

engines.aira_use: Check an employer's Glassdoor/Indeed ratings for a specific posting before applying or interviewing.
